Lemma
[Local compactness and openness] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0493, chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0495 ↗ def:chow-iii-i30-i31-gradient-regularity 1. appi:1.30,appi:1.33\group Critical point theory

The set gradient $ abla _\star r$ is locally compact. For $0< heta \le \pi /2$, the set of $ heta $-regular points and the corresponding cone of admissible directions are open.
Proof

\sketch Convergent unit vectors determine convergent minimizing geodesics by continuous dependence of the exponential map, so the limit remains in $ abla _\star r$. The openness statement follows by contradiction and compactness of the set gradient.

□
